gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-assistant: Commanding without any fuss, Bellota Text draws open, unshaded letters that stand out, while Assistant stays modest and contemporary beneath them. One is built to catch the eye; the other to be forgotten.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-asta-sans: Bellota Text has no calligraphic shading anywhere, just open, confident shapes that announce themselves. Asta Sans follows with tubelike, constant lines and an approachable e, a sans that lets the heading keep the spotlight.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-bai-jamjuree: Light and round, with no thick-and-thin variation at all, Bai Jamjuree reads like an easygoing plain sans. Bai Jamjuree against Bellota Text's commanding, open-shaped headings is where the pair gets its distinct character.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-barlow: Bellota Text has open c, e, and s shapes and no calligraphic shading. Barlow's neon-tube strokes and well-parted c tips make a contemporary sans, and it looks best a size or two below the heading.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-biz-udgothic: BIZ UDGothic gives every bowl a wide channel, a modern, professional plain sans with a tidy look throughout. Bellota Text is best at monoline display strokes; the body font is best at quiet text.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-biz-udpgothic: BIZ UDPGothic is generous with its letter spacing and leaves a clear channel into each round letter. BIZ UDPGothic is happiest a touch larger than you might expect, while Bellota Text's bowls stay unswollen up top.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-bpmf-huninn: Bpmf Huninn has a single-weight outline feel and a wide channel into every bowl, which gives it a modern, contemporary look. And Bellota Text's commanding, open shapes above it give the page a strong, distinctive top line.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-bpmf-zihi-kai-std: Neutral and approachable, Bpmf Zihi Kai Std keeps its counters open to the outside and adds a restrained swell to curves. Bellota Text is flat and strokes never vary; this one sits between flat and dramatic.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-cairo: Modern and professional, Cairo opens a wide channel into every bowl, a plain sans that never pushes for attention. Bellota Text's round bowls never swell or taper, and that unwavering outline is the pair's strongest quality.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-cambay: Bellota Text skims along with a stroke weight that never changes, giving its open c, e, and s shapes a commanding, easy ease. Cambay's rounds gap like a cracked bangle; give it a little extra size.
